The plate looks like a square dinner plate of about 26 cm. On it are a Caesar-style salad of romaine lettuce with creamy dressing and a small piece of broccoli.

Salad: the pile is roughly 7 cm by 15 cm and fairly loose. I estimate about 120 g of lettuce with dressing. Lettuce is about 15 kcal per 100 g, and the dressing adds perhaps 15 g at about 70 kcal, so the salad is roughly 90 kcal.

Broccoli: a single floret of about 40 g, which is about 15 kcal.

Total: about 160 g of food and about 105 kcal. The dressing may be heavier than I assumed, so I'll round the energy up to 110 kcal.
